message.content: In the city of Verona, Romeo Montague and Juliet Capulet, the children of two feuding families, fall deeply in love at a masquerade ball and secretly marry with the help of Friar Lawrence. However, their happiness is short-lived when Romeo’s friend Mercutio is killed by Juliet’s cousin Tybalt, leading Romeo to kill Tybalt in revenge and be banished from the city. Desperate to avoid an arranged marriage to Count Paris, Juliet takes a potion from the Friar to feign her death, but the message explaining the plan never reaches Romeo. Believing Juliet is truly dead, Romeo returns to Verona, kills Paris, and takes his own life beside her. Upon waking to find Romeo dead, Juliet stabs herself with his dagger, and the tragic deaths of the young lovers finally reconcile their warring families.
